explanation: Zero at D1 and GO, and zero at D2 unless the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition. In that case the value falls with time in the episode: about 10 in trials 1-15 (9 if the previous trial was unrewarded, 7-8 just after a rare trial), about 9 around trials 20-30, 7 around trials 40-45, 2-3 around trials 70-73, and 0 from about trial 75 on.
